Foreign Affairs Section

31 January, 1944.

Miss H.A. Gourova- Antecedents of

Miss Helen Alexeyevna Gourova, Russian, was born in Vladivostok on the 17-10-21.

Together with her parents she arrived in Harbin in 1922 where she resided till 1931. Following her arrival here, in 1932, she studied in the French Municipal College (1932-1937) and later, for 2 years, in the S.M.C. Public School for Girls (1937-1939).

（批：Gile Roumiantzoff wife）

To round up her education she completed a course of "Farmer's & Watts Business and Commercial College," Sze-chuen Road.

The following 2 years she resided with her parents who are living at 150/45 Tifeng Road. At the beginning of 1943 she secured a secretary's position with an Import & Export firm at 101 Rte. Magniny, which position she gave up at the beginning of this year.

Miss Gourova is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee and holds Registration Certificate No.9463 dated 3-2-43.

There is nothing detrimental to Miss Gourova's character in Police records.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs ,
Special Dept.

D. S. I.

1944年1月31日。

H.A. 古罗娃小姐——背景调查

海伦·阿列克谢耶夫娜·古罗娃（Helen Alexeyevna Gourova）小姐，俄国人，于1921年10月17日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。

1922年，她随父母抵达哈尔滨，并在那里居住至1931年。1932年抵沪后，她就读于法国公学（1932-1937），随后在工部局女子公立学校就读两年（1937-1939）。

（批注：吉尔·鲁缅采夫之妻）

为完成学业，她在四川路的“法默与瓦茨商业专科学校”（Farmer's & Watts Business and Commercial College）修完课程。

此后两年，她与居住在提丰路150/45号的父母同住。1943年初，她在马尼尼路101号的一家进出口公司获得秘书职位，并于今年初辞去该职。

古罗娃小姐已在俄国侨民委员会登记，持有1943年2月3日签发的第9463号登记证。

警方档案中没有任何不利于古罗娃小姐品行的记录。

特务处
外事科主管警官

D. S. I.
（印章：...）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Foreign Affairs Section Station. File No.................... Date.... 28-1-44.

SUBJECT: Miss H.A.Gourova-Antecedents of.

Miss Helen Alexeyevna Gourova, Russian, was born in Vladivostok on the 17-10-21.

Together with her parents she arrived in Harbin in 1922 where she resided till 1931. Following her arrival here, in 1932, she studied in the French Municipal College (1932-1937) and later, for 2 years, in the S.M.C. Public School for Girls (1937-1939). To round up her education she completed a course of "Farmer's & Watts Business and Commercial College", Szechuen Rd.

The following 2 years she resided with her parents who are living at 150/45 Tifeng Rd. At the beginning of 1943 she secured a secretary's position with an Import & Export firm at 101 Rte Magniny, which position she gave up at the beginning of this year.

Miss Gourova is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee and holds Registration Certificate No.9463 dated 3-2-43.

There is nothing detrimental to Miss Gourova's character in Police records.

It was further elicited that D.P.S.3 Roumiantseff and Miss Gourova were married on the 22-1-44 at the Community Church, 53 Av.Petain, by Mr.A.Gouroff, the bride's father, who is the pastor of the Russian Methodist Church at 242 Av.du Roi Albert, and who, for the period of 10 yrs (1932-1942) was employed by the "King's Daughters' Society" 686 Av.Foch, as interpreter and investigator.

The present address of the newlyweds is 101 Rte Magniny.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs
Intelligence Dept.

D.S.I.

（批：Well personal）

报告

外事科分站。档案号.................... 日期.... 1944年1月28日。

主题：H.A.古罗娃小姐——背景调查。

海伦·阿列克谢耶夫娜·古罗娃小姐，俄国人，于1921年10月17日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。

1922年，她随父母抵达哈尔滨，并在那里居住至1931年。1932年抵沪后，她就读于法国公学（1932-1937），随后在工部局女子公立学校就读两年（1937-1939）。为完成学业，她在四川路的“法默与瓦茨商业专科学校”修完课程。

此后两年，她与居住在提丰路150/45号的父母同住。1943年初，她在马尼尼路101号的一家进出口公司获得秘书职位，并于今年初辞去该职。

古罗娃小姐已在俄国侨民委员会登记，持有1943年2月3日签发的第9463号登记证。

警方档案中没有任何不利于古罗娃小姐品行的记录。

另查明，警务处三等巡查鲁缅采夫（Roumiantseff）与古罗娃小姐于1944年1月22日在贝当路53号的社区教堂结婚，由新娘之父A.古罗夫（A.Gouroff）主持婚礼。古罗夫先生是阿尔伯特王路242号俄国卫理公会教堂的牧师，并在1932年至1942年的十年间受雇于福煦路686号的“国王女儿社”（King's Daughters' Society），担任翻译和调查员。

新婚夫妇目前的住址是马尼尼路101号。

情报处
外事科主管警官

D.S.I.

（批注：个人情况良好）
（印章：归档）
